question: Exports of mangoes by India are a part of _______ method of measurement of its national income.
solution:
The correct answer is __**expenditure.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Exports of mangoes** by India contribute to the **expenditure method** of measuring its national income because it represents a portion of the country's** total exports, **which is a component of its overall expenditure.
 
• The expenditure method of measuring national income is one of** three primary methods **used, along with the income method and the value-added method.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **income method **measures national income by** adding up all of the income** earned by individuals and businesses in a country, while the value-added method calculates national income by **subtracting the cost of inputs** from the revenue generated by businesses.
 
• Circular income refers to the** flow of money b**etween different sectors of an economy.
 
• **Value-added** measures the increase in **value of a product **at each stage of production, rather than simply the final sale price.
